name: korean-web-typography
description: Korean web typography rules: Pretendard font stack and sizing, small-text size floors, heading line height, one family for digits and Latin, no monospace, word-break keep-all, no justification, the order of operations for line spacing, sparing use of em and en dashes in Korean body text, cards, tables and text sizes structured by the h1-h6 hierarchy, hover-only link underlines with a link-only color, and a right-edge overflow check at 375px.
